prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-screen painterly portrait mobile puzzle game background, 720:1520 aspect.
Primary request: Create 徽州水墨 as an EXPRESSIVE TRADITIONAL CHINESE INK-WASH LANDSCAPE filling the entire portrait. This is an outdoor painted river-and-mountains artwork, not a room, not an architectural border around an empty center.
Composition: sparse monochrome black/white inkbrush painting on softly fibrous offwhite silk/washi. At the UPPER LEFT, tiny distant white Huizhou houses with elegant black tile rooftops nestle beneath layered grey ink mountains. Mountain silhouettes rise in the upper third and disappear into pale mist. A misty river flows diagonally through the center, very faint watery grey gradients and suggestions of distant bank, so the central middle remains open, light and low-contrast. A single expressive dark pine branch enters from the far LEFT at upper-middle, asymmetric and restrained; no matching branch on the other side. The lower half gradually becomes broad offwhite washi/silk scroll surface with visible subtle fibers and faint pooled ink wash at the far edges. At the extreme LOWER RIGHT only, a small cropped black inkstone and one brush rest on the silk. The painting feels continuous, no rectangular frame or blank bordered panel.
Rendering: true traditional literati landscape ink painting, dry-brush texture, feathered water edges, expressive brushstroke rhythm, translucent layered grey ink mountains, sparse elegant black strokes, deep atmospheric mist. Highly crafted mobile game visual artwork. Almost entirely monochrome ivory, warm grey and black; no saturated green or gold, no realistic 3D rendering.
Reserved overlay composition: UI will be added later, so do NOT draw any UI. Central card cluster x21–75%, y34–57% must remain pale mist and faint ink gradients with no distinct objects, houses or dark pine limbs in that central area. Logo later y0–10%; levelbar y10–15%; tray y74–82%; buttons y91–96%. Keep artwork clean behind these.
STRICT NEGATIVES: no words, calligraphy, characters, red seals, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, UI, buttons, cards, trays, phone frame. No indoor decor, no curtains, lamps, vases, pedestals, hotpot or wooden tabletop. No giant blank rectangular paper wall. No symmetrical frame. This must read unmistakably as a full-screen sparse ink landscape with distant Huizhou houses and mountains.
